historical_commentary.text: Clipboard/pasteboard and drag-and-drop interoperability with the host OS remains a relevant capability in 4D today, so the underlying concept holds up, though the specific v11 SQL-era Pasteboard command set has been extended and refined across many subsequent 4D releases.
related_updates: 4D's clipboard and drag-and-drop command set has continued to be extended in versions after v11 SQL, with broader data-type and cross-platform support added over time
